div.head: Rect 1.1
div.ab: eac of manegum landum mare landriht arist to cyniges gebanne swilce is. deorhege to cyniges hame 7 scorp to friðscipe . 7 sæweard 7 heafodweard 7 fyrdweard . æl|mesfeoh 7 cyricsceat 7 mænige oðere mistlice ðinge.

Also, on many estates more land-right is originated at the king’s command such as, [to maintain] the animal-hedge for the king’s estate, and [to supply] equipment for a defence ship, and to guard the coast, and [to be a] head-guard and [to perform] military watch, [to give] alms money and church tribute and many other diverse things.

[1.1] Eac of manegum landum mare landriht arist to cyniges gebanne, swilce is deorhege to cyniges hame 7 scorp to friðscipe 7 sæweard 7 heafodweard 7 fyrdweard, ælmesfeoh 7 cyricsceat 7 mænige oðere mistlice ðingc.
